summary: The active discount flow runs from the checkout page and UI through the quote route to coupon storage.
findings: Ordered flow: app/checkout/page.tsx CheckoutPage -> components/PricePreview.tsx PricePreview -> lib/api/client.ts fetchQuote -> app/api/quote/route.ts POST -> services/pricing.ts priceQuote -> db/coupons.ts findCoupon.
Coverage exists in test/pricing.test.ts and e2e/checkout.spec.ts.
legacy/price.ts is an unused decoy that is not imported by the active flow.
The server route must validate untrusted coupon and subtotal input.
